titleEn: Customer sends a cart that becomes an order

ar: العميل بعت سلة ايه اللي بيحصل؟
en: What happens when a customer sends a cart?

steps: Lines are re-read from the Store (price, stock); sold-out items reported; order created in Ebda Store; payment choice COD / InstaPay / link / card
edgeCases: 24-hour window closed: free text blocked (Meta 131047), only an approved template can be sent
Ebda Store bridge down/unbound: store-linked features fall back (agent answers text only; orders cannot be created; COD outcomes cannot be recorded) and alert fires
Order state belongs to Ebda Store
